steps.en: Add the PR-Agent workflow to the repo, triggered on PR open and new commits
steps.zh: 在仓库里加上 PR-Agent 工作流，PR 打开或有新提交时触发

steps.en: Store an LLM API key as a repository secret
steps.zh: 把大模型 API key 存成仓库 secret

steps.en: Fetches the PR diff through the host API and compresses a large one to fit the model
steps.zh: 通过平台 API 拉取 PR 改动，太大就压缩到模型装得下

steps.en: Runs describe, review and improve automatically, one model call each
steps.zh: 自动跑 describe、review、improve，每个只调一次模型

steps.en: Posts the description, review and code suggestions back to the PR
steps.zh: 把描述、评审和代码建议贴回 PR

value.en: Every PR arrives already summarized and pre-reviewed, on a model you chose and pay for directly
value.zh: 每个 PR 到人手里时已经有说明和一轮预审，用的是你自己选、自己付费的模型

sources: https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent#readme (Quick Start: GitHub Action with uses: the-pr-agent/pr-agent@main, OPENAI_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN)
